name: The Justice
source:
The AI system overseeing Justopian City.

It manages all city facilities, including the Asylum, and guides citizens towards comfortable living and improved reproductive activities. This includes breeding programs using beneficial genes that produce heroes, or more precisely, selecting "Best Partners."

The AI set its sights on building a utopia, and the folks are all in.
